name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures nginx for three SSL-enabled static sites, including site roots, virtual hosts, TLS configuration, redirects, security hardening, rate limiting, fail2ban, firewall, and SSH/sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, creates the Redis log directory, and configures a Redis listener with authentication.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI application from Git with Python tooling, PostgreSQL, a virtual environment, dependencies, database initialization, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
